notes.oconnor-1: Pinned on OSM's O'Connor Complex Building 1 (way/941686532), the north building of the O'Connor apartment complex west of Lourdes Hall (Nazareth campus map, www2.naz.edu/campus-map).
notes.otto-a-shults-community-center: The Shults Center holds Nazareth's dining hall along with Kidera Gym and the bookstore (www2.naz.edu/dining); its name doesn't say dining.
notes.health-and-counseling-services: The student health and counselling clinic, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.stone-west-admissions-house: The admissions office house at 4141 East Avenue, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.la-maison-francaise: A residential language house (Nazareth's French house), student housing rather than a class building.
notes.casa-hispana: A residential language house (Nazareth's Spanish house), student housing rather than a class building.
notes.casa-italiana: A residential language house (Nazareth's Italian house), student housing rather than a class building.
notes.alumni-pavilion: An open-sided pavilion (OSM amenity=shelter), not a class building.
